question.problem:
Let $X$ and $Y$ be two continuous random variables with the joint probability density function

$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}-1}\operatorname{sin}⁡(x+y), & 0\le x\le \frac{\pi }{4},\,0\le y\le \frac{\pi }{4}, \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Find the expression for the marginal PDF ${f}_{Y}(y).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14272472/assets/cc0e5c2c20d8067cabecf709454d33e847fe80f5c353b363db64ae2709d638d5.svg)
Find the expression for the marginal PDF $f_Y(y).$
current_example.worked_solution:
If $X$ and $Y$ are two continuous random variables with joint probability density function $f(x, y),$ then the marginal density functions for $X$ and $Y$ are

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(x)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}y,\,{f}_{Y}(y)={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }f(x,y)\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

In our case, the marginal density function of $Y$ for $0\leq y \leq1$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y}(y) & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{15}{7}{x}^{2}{y}^{4}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{15}{7}{y}^{4}{[\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3}]}_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{5}{7}{y}^{4}[{x}^{3}]_{x=1}^{x=2} \\  & =\frac{5}{7}{y}^{4}({2}^{3}-{1}^{3}) \\  & =5{y}^{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the full expression for $f_Y(y)$ is given by
